title: StarRocks health: BE disk/tablet load + FE state
description: The nexus-cli health verb for StarRocks: per-BE disk usage + tablet count + per-FE state, from SHOW BACKENDS / SHOW PROC.

observe.what: per-BE TabletNum (load balance) + DataUsedCapacity / AvailCapacity (disk headroom) -- the health signals the verb surfaces

whatProves: health surfaces per-BE tablet load + disk capacity + FE liveness -- the operational health the StarRocksAdapter health verb reports.
